thread_execution_reports_capture_call_co.name: thread_execution_reports_capture_call_coherent
thread_execution_reports_capture_call_co.value: ("thread_execution_reports"."capture" IS NULL AND "thread_execution_reports"."capture_tool_call_id" IS NULL) OR ("thread_execution_reports"."capture" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_execution_reports"."capture_tool_call_id" IS NOT NULL)

thread_execution_reports_terminal_cohere.name: thread_execution_reports_terminal_coherent
thread_execution_reports_terminal_cohere.value: ("thread_execution_reports"."outcome" IS NULL AND "thread_execution_reports"."terminal_at" IS NULL) OR ("thread_execution_reports"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_execution_reports"."source" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_execution_reports"."summary" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_execution_reports"."terminal_at" IS NOT NULL)

thread_execution_reports_publication_tim.name: thread_execution_reports_publication_timestamp_coherent
thread_execution_reports_publication_tim.value: ("thread_execution_reports"."publication" IN ('none','pending') AND "thread_execution_reports"."published_at" IS NULL) OR ("thread_execution_reports"."publication" = 'published' AND "thread_execution_reports"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

thread_inbox_messages_hand_back.name: thread_inbox_messages_hand_back
thread_inbox_messages_hand_back.value: "thread_inbox_messages"."handed_back_by" IS NULL OR ("thread_inbox_messages"."delivered_at" IS NOT NULL AND "thread_inbox_messages"."delivered_by_turn_id" IS NULL AND "thread_inbox_messages"."intent" = 'message')

thread_inbox_messages_body_valid.name: thread_inbox_messages_body_valid
thread_inbox_messages_body_valid.value: (CASE WHEN "thread_inbox_messages"."intent" = 'control' THEN ("thread_inbox_messages"."body"->>'kind' = 'compact' OR ("thread_inbox_messages"."body"->>'kind' = 'write_mode' AND "thread_inbox_messages"."body"->>'mode' IN ('direct','draft'))) ELSE "thread_inbox_messages"."body"->>'kind' IN ('text','context','work_context_refresh') END) IS TRUE

threads_parent_created_active.name: threads_parent_created_active
threads_parent_created_active.where: "threads"."parent_thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."deleted_at" IS NULL

threads_spawn_origin_required_fields.name: threads_spawn_origin_required_fields
threads_spawn_origin_required_fields.value: "threads"."origin_type" != 'spawn' OR ("threads"."kind" = 'subagent' AND "threads"."parent_thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."origin_turn_id" IS NOT NULL AND "threads"."spawn_status" IS NOT NULL)

threads_organic_origin_fields_empty.name: threads_organic_origin_fields_empty
threads_organic_origin_fields_empty.value: "threads"."origin_type" IS NOT NULL OR ("threads"."parent_thread_id" IS NULL AND "threads"."origin_turn_id" IS NULL AND "threads"."spawn_status" IS NULL)

branch_tree_changes_moved_shape.name: branch_tree_changes_moved_shape
branch_tree_changes_moved_shape.value:
CASE WHEN "branch_tree_changes"."moved" THEN "branch_tree_changes"."moved_name" IS NOT NULL AND "branch_tree_changes"."moved_extension" IS NOT NULL
        AND ("branch_tree_changes"."moved_folder_id" IS NULL) <> ("branch_tree_changes"."moved_root_source_id" IS NULL)
        ELSE "branch_tree_changes"."moved_folder_id" IS NULL AND "branch_tree_changes"."moved_root_source_id" IS NULL
          AND "branch_tree_changes"."moved_name" IS NULL AND "branch_tree_changes"."moved_extension" IS NULL END

branch_tree_changes_revision_present.name: branch_tree_changes_revision_present
branch_tree_changes_revision_present.value: NOT ("branch_tree_changes"."moved" OR "branch_tree_changes"."deleted") OR "branch_tree_changes"."revision" IS NOT NULL

context_sources_project_scope_slug.name: context_sources_project_scope_slug
context_sources_project_scope_slug.where: "context_sources"."work_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."root_thread_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."chat_thread_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."deleted_at" IS NULL

context_sources_work_slug.name: context_sources_work_slug
context_sources_work_slug.where: "context_sources"."work_id" IS NOT NULL AND "context_sources"."deleted_at" IS NULL

context_sources_exactly_one_scope.name: context_sources_exactly_one_scope
context_sources_exactly_one_scope.value: ("context_sources"."scope" = 'project' AND "context_sources"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "context_sources"."work_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."root_thread_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."chat_thread_id" IS NULL) OR ("context_sources"."scope" = 'work' AND "context_sources"."project_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."work_id" IS NOT NULL AND "context_sources"."root_thread_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."chat_thread_id" IS NULL) OR ("context_sources"."scope" = 'lineage' AND "context_sources"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "context_sources"."work_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."root_thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "context_sources"."chat_thread_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."slug" = 'scratch') OR ("context_sources"."scope" = 'chat' AND "context_sources"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "context_sources"."work_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."root_thread_id" IS NULL AND "context_sources"."chat_thread_id" IS NOT NULL AND "context_sources"."slug" = 'uploads')

documents_purge_candidates.name: documents_purge_candidates
documents_purge_candidates.where: "documents"."content_purged_at" IS NULL AND "documents"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."deletion_reason" = 'deleted' AND NOT "documents"."hidden" AND "documents"."deleted_by_work_id" IS NULL

documents_context_root_name_live.name: documents_context_root_name_live
documents_context_root_name_live.where: "documents"."folder_id" IS NULL AND "documents"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND NOT "documents"."hidden"

documents_removal_presence.name: documents_removal_presence
documents_removal_presence.value: ("documents"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL) = ("documents"."deletion_reason" IS NOT NULL)

folders_context_root_name_live.name: folders_context_root_name_live
folders_context_root_name_live.where: "folders"."parent_id" IS NULL AND "folders"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND NOT "folders"."hidden"

folders_nonlive_location.name: folders_nonlive_location
folders_nonlive_location.where: ("folders"."hidden" AND "folders"."deleted_at" IS NULL) OR (NOT "folders"."hidden" AND "folders"."deleted_at" IS NOT NULL)

works_no_work_handle.name: works_no_work_handle
works_no_work_handle.value: ("works"."is_no_work" AND "works"."handle" IS NULL) OR (NOT "works"."is_no_work" AND "works"."handle" IS NOT NULL)

document_edits_tree_change_valid.name: document_edits_tree_change_valid
document_edits_tree_change_valid.value:
"document_edits"."tree_change" IS NULL OR (
        "document_edits"."tree_change"->>'op' IN ('create','move','delete','restore','settle')
        AND "document_edits"."tree_change"->'destination'->>'kind' IN ('live','draft')
        AND jsonb_typeof("document_edits"."tree_change"->'seq') = 'number'
        AND jsonb_typeof("document_edits"."tree_change"->'targets') = 'array'
        AND ("document_edits"."tree_change"->>'op' <> 'settle' OR "document_edits"."tree_change" ? 'settles')
      )

change_trail_shells_owner_shape.name: change_trail_shells_owner_shape
change_trail_shells_owner_shape.value: ("change_trail_shells"."owner_kind" = 'turn' AND "change_trail_shells"."turn_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("change_trail_shells"."owner_kind" = 'shared' AND "change_trail_shells"."turn_id" IS NULL)

change_trail_shells_state_counts_valid.name: change_trail_shells_state_counts_valid
change_trail_shells_state_counts_valid.value: "change_trail_shells"."state" IN ('building', 'settling', 'settled') AND "change_trail_shells"."version" > 0 AND "change_trail_shells"."change_count" >= 0 AND "change_trail_shells"."document_count" >= 0 AND (("change_trail_shells"."state" = 'settled') = ("change_trail_shells"."settled_at" IS NOT NULL))

document_drafts_seed_record_shape.name: document_drafts_seed_record_shape
document_drafts_seed_record_shape.value: (("document_drafts"."seed_origins" IS NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_live_room" IS NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_live_snapshot" IS NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_draft_snapshot" IS NULL) OR ("document_drafts"."kind" = 'work_draft' AND "document_drafts"."seed_origins" IS NOT NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_live_room" IS NOT NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_live_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_draft_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)) AND (("document_drafts"."seed_live_state" IS NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_live_position" IS NULL) OR ("document_drafts"."seed_live_state" IS NOT NULL AND "document_drafts"."seed_live_position" IS NOT NULL))

document_drafts_owner_shape.name: document_drafts_owner_shape
document_drafts_owner_shape.value: ("document_drafts"."kind" = 'work_draft' AND "document_drafts"."thread_id" IS NULL) OR ("document_drafts"."kind" = 'thread_peer' AND "document_drafts"."thread_id" IS NOT NULL)
